name: comp-446

frames.best_why: Open menu with Documentation, Themes and GitHub, one row hovered, under the whole breadcrumb trail.

tagline: A breadcrumb trail whose ellipsis opens a menu of skipped pages.
summary: A flat line of breadcrumb links with a three-dot button in the middle that drops a small menu of the pages left out: Documentation, Themes and GitHub.
appearance: One line of small grey breadcrumb labels separated by chevrons runs across black and ends in a bright Breadcrumb. In the middle, a three-dot button opens a dark rounded menu holding three plain text rows.
behaviour: Clicking the three dots drops the menu beneath it; hovering a row fills it grey, and the trigger gains a soft rounded outline on hover or focus. Choosing a row closes the menu.
demo_content: Home, Components, Breadcrumb, and menu rows Documentation, Themes, GitHub.
search_phrases: breadcrumb with a three dot menu
show more pages in a path
dots in the middle of a breadcrumb
use_when: Long file or category paths where the middle crumbs should stay out of the way.
avoid_when: When every crumb must be visible at once: the middle pages hide behind a click.
customise: The path labels, separators and the three menu rows are written inside; showing a real path means editing those items. Hover and menu styling come from shared pieces.
weight_why: A handful of text links and one small menu; no loops or heavy animation.

a11y.note: The ellipsis trigger has a screen-reader label and the menu is keyboard reachable; no reduced-motion handling.

polish_why: Clean menu rows and a neat focus ring, but otherwise a standard breadcrumb.
